questions.explanation: The trap is: 25% of 60 is just 25. Percent means per hundred instead: 25% is one quarter, and one quarter of 60 is 60 / 4 = 15.

questions.answer: 25% = 25/100 = 1/4: divide the top and the bottom by 25.
